authors_reviews.title: Great ongoing holiday craft!
authors_reviews.text: How much fun for my grandchildren, ages 6, 4 & 1 (and yes their mother, too) at Christmas! Early December it was spread out on table where they could come and go with their coloring efforts. I was pleased that it was such a large size with so much coloring that it kept them busy through the upcoming holiday; so many of our craft projects are finished too quickly. The picture scene was nice, too.I bought paints and markers, which all worked well but they ended up mostly using crayons and the colors showed up bright and vivid (we always use Crayola). I was afraid the paper might be a little waxy, but it wasn’t at all.I was happily surprised with the good paper quality, and there were no rips, even at the hands of the small ones. By Christmas, it was hung on the wall for a decoration and still not one time did it rip.Price was really great. I’ll buy another for this holiday season.
authors_reviews.author: DK

authors_reviews.title: Jumbo Christmas Hit!
authors_reviews.text: The OHOME Xmas Giant Coloring Poster/Tablecloth is a versatile holiday craft designed for kids but enjoyable for all ages. Measuring 30 x 72 inches, this jumbo paper coloring banner is perfect for Christmas parties, classroom decorations, or even as a festive tablecloth. It’s a great way to engage in creative activities during the holiday season.The Pros:• Therapeutic and Fun: Coloring is a fantastic stress reliever and offers educational and developmental benefits. It’s a fun way to bring the family together or even liven up an office party.• Versatile Use: Can be used as a decorative poster or a unique tablecloth, adding a festive touch to any setting.• Quality Material: Made from sturdy, thick, and durable paper, this poster can withstand hours of coloring fun without tearing easily.• Variety of Themes: Available in different themes throughout the year, making it a versatile choice for various occasions.• Great Value: Offers a significant amount of entertainment for the price, making it a budget-friendly option for holiday activities.The Cons:• None Noted: The product meets expectations for quality, entertainment, and versatility.We had a blast using the OHOME Xmas Giant Coloring Poster during a family gathering. It provided hours of fun for both kids and adults, proving that you’re never too old to enjoy coloring. The paper quality was impressive—no smudging or tearing, even with enthusiastic use. We loved that it doubled as a festive tablecloth, adding a personal touch to our holiday decor. With various themes available, we’re excited to try out different designs throughout the year.The OHOME Xmas Giant Coloring Poster/Tablecloth is a fantastic addition to any holiday celebration, offering endless fun and creative expression. Whether you’re using it for a family activity, classroom project, or office party, it’s sure to be a hit. The quality, versatility, and affordability make it a must-have for anyone looking to add a bit of holiday cheer to their events. Highly recommended for creating festive memories!
